title: KC Concepcion's rushing TD pulls Cleveland to within one point of the Texans
text:

 Presented By KC Concepcion's rushing TD pulls Cleveland to within one point of the Texans
 Cleveland Browns wide receiver KC Concepcion races to the corner of the end zone, pulling the Browns to within one point tying the Houston Texans.
